weekLabel: Week of Jun 19-26 · refreshed Fri Jun 19. Tap a source to confirm before you go.

events.name: Arts Fest Beverly
events.meta: Free · Beverly (Cabot St). Big, easy street festival close to home: 125+ artists, free kids' activities, food downtown. Whole-family fit; add Lynch Park for the ocean. Park a side street and walk in. source

events.name: St. Peter's Fiesta - Gloucester (opens this week)
events.meta: Free · Gloucester waterfront. The headline pick: carnival rides, seine boat races, the greasy pole, food, fireworks. Peaks the weekend of Jun 27-28. Ocean + seafood + teen magnet. Go early for parking. source

events.name: Boston Pizza Festival
events.meta: $10-15 incl. 2 slices (verify) · Boston, City Hall Plaza. Pizza-tossing shows, live music, DJs, games. Teen magnet, easy to graze. source

events.name: Asian Food Festival - Rose Kennedy Greenway
events.meta: Free entry · Boston. Outdoor food festival downtown, easy to graze and bail. Pair with the Greenway carousel for Isabella. source

events.name: Stone Zoo - free for dads (Father's Day)
events.meta: Free for fathers · Stoneham (also Franklin Park Zoo). Close to home, low-lift Father's Day outing that works for Isabella. source

events.name: Newburyport Farmers' Market + boardwalk
events.meta: Free · Newburyport. Market plus the boardwalk and waterfront park. One of the best walkable harbor towns in range. source

events.name: Infinity Song - Prescott Park (Portsmouth NH)
events.meta: $20 suggested donation · Portsmouth NH waterfront. Live music on the Wilcox Main Stage, lawn open, bring chairs. Pair with a Portsmouth dinner. source

events.name: Salisbury Beach Friday Beach Party + weekend fireworks
events.meta: Free · Salisbury oceanfront. Free oldies show Fri 7:15pm, Sat concerts 7:30pm with fireworks over the water ~10:15pm. Easy beach evening for all five. source

events.name: Amesbury Brewfest
events.meta: Ticketed (verify) · Amesbury. Dave's brewery pick this week: local pours in an easy outdoor setting. Pair with dinner in Amesbury or Newburyport. source
